metadata.summary: UK Biobank is a prospective, population-based cohort of ~500,000 participants aged 40–69 recruited across the United Kingdom, with deep longitudinal phenotyping: genetic, lifestyle, electronic health records, imaging, and biosamples. Roughly 100,000 participants have multimodal MRI (brain, heart, abdomen) plus further imaging.
metadata.purpose: Supports myriad epidemiological and ML studies

ethics.license: application-based access (academic free tier / industry fee)

extraction.notes: Baseline card derived solely from dataset_catalog.xlsx real metadata; remaining fields require paper/README or manual completion.
pending_verification: geography.countries is heuristically inferred from limitation text; requires manual verification

bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: UK-only; age 40–69; healthy-volunteer bias; underrepresentation of minority ethnic groups and younger/older adults
bias_and_limitations.subgroup_coverage: Limited coverage of non-White ethnic groups; no explicit reporting of sex distribution in source text
bias_and_limitations.missing_data: Imaging data available only for ~100,000 participants; EHR completeness varies by linkage status and time

tasks_and_use.excluded_tasks: Real-time clinical decision support; use without ethics/approval

data_origin.selection_rationale: Prospective, population-based cohort recruitment across the UK
data_origin.sampling_strategy: Participants aged 40–69 recruited from general population; MRI sub-study (~100,000) is a subset

population.target_population: Adults aged 40–69 in the United Kingdom
population.missing_groups: UK-only; middle-aged/older volunteers (healthy-volunteer bias); pediatric, pregnant, and critically ill populations underrepresented

annotation.labeling_provenance: Phenotypes derived from EHR, self-report, imaging expert review, and genotyping pipelines
